subject: general
question: A hemispherical bowl has a radius of 7 cm. It is to be painted from inside as well as outside. Find the cost of painting it at the rate of Rs.40 per 20 cm²? (Take thickness of the bowl as negligible).
solution:
**Given:- **

A hemispherical bowl has a radius = 7cm 

The cost of painting it at the rate of Rs.40 per 20 cm² 

**Formula used:-**

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere = 2πr²

**Calculation:- **

Inside Surface Area = 2π(7 cm)² = 2 × 22/7 × 49 = 308 cm²

Outside Surface Area = 2π(7 cm)² = 308 cm²

Total Surface Area = Inside Surface Area + Outside Surface Area

Total Surface Area = 616cm² 

The cost of painting this area at the given rate of Rs. 40 for 20 cm²

Cost = (Total Surface Area / 20 cm²) × Rs. 40

Cost = (616 / 20) × 40 = 1232 Rs. 

**∴The cost of painting both the inside and outside of the hemispherical Rs.__1232__.**
